title: Mayor of Frankfurt - Wikipedia
content: # Mayor of Frankfurt. The **Mayor of Frankfurt** (German: *Oberbürgermeister* (male) or *Oberbürgermeisterin* (female), sometimes translated as "**Lord Mayor**") is the highest-ranking member of city government in Frankfurt, Germany. The mayor was traditionally elected by the city council. Three people have won election since then: Petra Roth (CDU "Christian Democratic Union (Germany)")), Peter Feldmann (SPD) and Mike Josef (SPD). In November 2022, following a successful recall election against Feldmann, Nargess Eskandari-Grünberg (Green) was the interim mayor of Frankfurt for six months. Current mayor Mike Josef (SPD) assumed the office in May 2023 following the election with 51.7% of the votes against the CDU candidate Uwe Becker. The present position of *Oberbürgermeister* was introduced in 1868 following the occupation of the city by the Kingdom of Prussia. In 1933 following the appointment of Adolf Hitler as Chancellor of Germany, Ludwig Landmann – Frankfurt's first Jewish mayor – was expelled from the council, and Nazi Party member Friedrich Krebs "Friedrich Krebs (mayor)") was appointed in his place.

title: World Mayor: History 2004 to 2022
content: | World Mayor History  2004 to 2023    Elke Kahr,  Mayor of Graz, awarded  the 2023 World Mayor Prize  **Graz Mayor from 2021 to date**  Elke Kahr, Mayor of Graz, Austria, has been awarded the 2023 World Mayor Prize for her selfless dedication to her city and its people, as city councillor and mayor. Her decision to share a large part of her salary with people in need has attracted worldwide admiration    **Commendation:** “Elke Kahr, the Mayor of Graz, is a shining example of leadership and dedication. Graz is fortunate to have such a dedicated and visionary leader.”    **From Mayor Kahr’s essay:** Personal contact with people, with the citizens of Graz, has always been the most important aspect for me, as a local politician. IN GREATER DETAIL      Ahmed Aboutaleb World Mayor 2021Ahmed Aboutaleb,  Mayor of Rotterdam, jointly awarded  the 2021 World Mayor Prize  **Rotterdam Mayor from 2009 to date**  Ahmed Aboutaleb, one of the longest-serving and most respected mayors in Europe, has led the City of Rotterdam, Netherlands, since 2009 with courage, patience and humility.

title: AfD ally wins mayoral election in east Germany | Germany | The Guardian
content: Tim Lochner (second right), the AfD candidate for mayor, and Bodo Herath (right), leader of the AfD city council faction in Pirna, celebrate after their party's election win.. Result in Pirna is party’s second mayoral win in east in six months and first time it has taken a lord mayor post. Tim Lochner, who is not a member of the AfD but ran with the party’s backing, in effect as its representative, secured 38.5% of the vote in the second round of a three-way runoff in the Saxon town of Pirna, near Dresden and close to the Czech border. It is the first time the AfD, which is riding high in the polls across the country, has secured the post of *Oberbürgermeister*, similar to the post of lord mayor, designated to towns and cities of a significant size. Writing on X, the Saxon branch of the Green party said: “We find the election of a mayor from a party which was classified as rightwing extremist by the office of the protection of the constitution just last week devastating.”.
